name: Cancel Non Deliverable Forward Opening V 02
definition: Scope|The CancelNonDeliverableForwardOpening message is sent by a participant to a central system or to a counterparty to notify the cancellation of the opening of a non deliverable trade previously confirmed by the sender.|Usage|The message will contain a Related Reference to link it to the previously sent notification. It may contain a reason for cancellation.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: Provides references and date of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Specifies the rate of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.

ValuationConditions.name: Valuation Conditions
ValuationConditions.definition: Specifies the valuation conditions of the non deliverable trade which is cancelled.
